candidate_sentence_map.S1: Ambu reported a solid start to fiscal 2025/26, with revenue growth continuing despite difficult comparables and significant foreign-exchange and tariff headwinds.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Q1 revenue increased to DKK 1,558m from DKK 1,510m, representing reported growth of 3.2% and organic growth of 8.6%, compared with 19.5% organic growth in the prior-year quarter.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Endoscopy Solutions remained the main growth engine, generating organic growth of 14.4% and accounting for 63% of revenue.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Urology, ENT, & GI grew organically by 21.0%, primarily driven by the aScope 4 portfolio and continued momentum for aScope 5 Uretero, while Respiratory grew by 8.3%, supported by bronchoscopy solutions, aScope 5 adoption, and the launch of SureSight video laryngoscope solutions.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Anesthesia & Patient Monitoring delivered flat organic growth of -0.1%, reflecting an exceptionally strong comparable quarter last year.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Anesthesia declined by 1.2%, while Patient Monitoring grew by 1.1%.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: North America and Europe both recorded solid organic growth of 9.8% and 9.7%, respectively.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Rest of World declined by 1.6% because of order fluctuations and high prior-year revenue.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: EBIT before special items fell to DKK 164m from DKK 243m, reducing the margin to 10.5% from 16.1%.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: The reported margin was affected by tariff costs of more than DKK 50m and foreign-exchange headwinds; excluding these factors, the EBIT margin was 15.2%.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: Continued investment in commercial infrastructure also increased operating expenses, with the OPEX ratio rising to 50.3% from 45.2%.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Gross margin declined modestly to 60.8% from 61.3%.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: EBITDA before special items decreased to DKK 261m from DKK 331m, while net profit declined to DKK 118m from DKK 183m.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Earnings per share fell to DKK 0.44 from DKK 0.68.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: Cash generation was weaker, with operating cash flow of DKK 106m compared with DKK 144m and free cash flow before acquisitions of DKK 13m compared with DKK 69m.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Elevated net working capital, particularly inventories, was maintained to support growth and manage geopolitical uncertainties, while cash flow was also affected by tariffs and foreign exchange.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Ambu ended the quarter with DKK 735m in cash and net interest-bearing debt of negative DKK 178m, indicating a net cash position.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: The company paid dividends and initiated its DKK 150m share buyback program, purchasing DKK 38m of treasury shares.
candidate_sentence_map.S20: Ambu maintained its full-year guidance for 10–13% organic revenue growth, an EBIT margin before special items of 12–14%, and cash conversion above 40%.
candidate_sentence_map.S21: Growth and margins are expected to be stronger in the second half, with Endoscopy Solutions targeted to grow by approximately 15% and Anesthesia & Patient Monitoring by mid-single digits.
